title: Link a computer: full-access warning
summary: Says in plain words that the computer gets full access to the chats, and that a person who asked for the scan is a scammer. The continue button waits through the short cooldown of security.md rule 5 (ADR 0116, ADR 0118 order steps 1 and 2).

secondsLeft.description: Seconds until continue works. Starts at webLinkCooldownSeconds (registries/accounts.json) when the screen shows, and counts down once per second.

appear.effect: Plays the web_link_warning haptic (registries/haptics.json) and starts the countdown. The countdown never starts before the screen is in front.

continue.effect: Only when canContinue. Opens link-computer-approve, which asks for the biometric check first.

cancel.effect: ContinuationMessageSender.cancel, then GrantLoginWithQrCodeTask.cancel. The computer does not sign in. Closes the flow back to Linked devices.

notes: The warning comes after the secure channel (GrantQrLoginProgress.waitingForAuth) and before the biometric check and the MAS page (ADR 0118 order). The hidden password is not read on this screen.
While secondsLeft is above 0, the continue button shows bipe_pause_countdown with secondsLeft and does nothing. Cancel always works.
The cooldown is a fixed wait, not a check. Leaving the app and coming back does not skip it: the countdown restarts at webLinkCooldownSeconds when the screen comes back to the front.
Keep webLinkCooldownSeconds short: the rendezvous session lives 60 seconds from the QR code (link-computer-scan notes).
Calm voice (linguagem.md section 5): no fear words, no exclamation. The warning colour and icon come from the trust UI tokens, not from the text.

Bipe logic: the Android approval controller counts down from BipeRegistries.WEB_LINK_COOLDOWN_SECONDS (libraries/bipe weblink BipeWebApprovalController, step WARNING). The generated constant is the source on both platforms.
